question_or_proposition: Does the Part I.A clause prohibiting discharge of visible films of oil, globules of oil, grease or solids in or on the water or coatings on stream banks establish a purely qualitative effluent limitation (not subject to numeric compliance comparison against reported measurements), and what is the scope of its application with respect to which substances and which assessment locations (point of discharge versus receiving water or stream banks)?
required_context: FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS section on page 5 including the adjacent sample-collection location sentence
Part I.A effluent characteristics and monitoring table on page 4
NO DISCHARGE reporting provisions on page 6
notes: The nominated span is a non-numeric, appearance-based effluent prohibition. Resolving its character and scope affects whether Purpose A classifies related reported measurements as having an applicable numeric limit or as outside numeric compliance comparison, and affects Purpose C semantics for periods lacking an ordinary numeric result for visible oil, grease, solids, or stream-bank effects.
